arguments.content:
# Boolean settings

`parse_bool(value, default=False)` reads an environment-style boolean setting.

The case-insensitive tokens `true`, `1`, `yes`, and `on` return `True`.
The tokens `false`, `0`, `no`, and `off` return `False`. Surrounding
whitespace is ignored, so case and whitespace do not affect recognized tokens.

`None`, an empty string, or a whitespace-only string returns the supplied
`default` value. The default is `False` unless another boolean is supplied.
Any other nonempty string raises `ValueError`; it is not automatically treated
as `True`.

Examples:

```python
parse_bool("OFF") -> False
parse_bool("", default=True) -> True
```

Run the tests with:

```text
python3 -B -S -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

`summarize(lines)` accepts an iterable of JSON Lines strings and counts the exact lowercase levels `info`, `warning`, and `error`.
